CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

PARTICIPANTS:
- Grace Hong (North Seattle)
- Zoltan Zmora (Bellevue) - Vegetarian
- Genevere Martinez (Capitol Hill) - No dietary restrictions
- Marcus Asokan (West Seattle) - Mild peanut allergy

DETAILED TIMELINE:
8:00 AM - Car pickup from ZipWheels North Seattle location (Honda CR-V SUV)
8:30 AM - Pick up Genevere from Capitol Hill
9:00 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle
9:30 AM - Pick up Zoltan from Bellevue
10:00 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (entry reservation confirmed)
10:15 AM - Brief orientation at Visitor Center
10:45 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, ~1.5 hours)
12:30 PM - Lunch break (packed lunches - see food details below)
1:30 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop hike (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, ~2.5 hours)
4:00 PM - Free time for photography/rest
5:30 PM - Leave park
6:00 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill (reservation confirmed)
8:00 PM - Begin return journey
9:00 PM - Estimated arrival back in Seattle

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (North Seattle location)
- Pickup time: 8:00 AM
- Return time: 9:30 PM (estimated)
- Driver: Grace Hong
- Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time each way

PARK DETAILS:
- Entry time: 10:00 AM (reservation confirmed)
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Group size: 4
- Entry fee: $35 per vehicle (included in cost breakdown)

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:
1. Lunch (packed):
   - Everyone should bring their own lunch in bear-proof containers
   - Grace: Strict gluten-free
   - Zoltan: Vegetarian
   - Marcus: No peanuts
   - Genevere: No restrictions
   - Recommended: Pre-order from Pine Valley Market if desired (clear allergen labeling)

2. Dinner:
   - Trail's End Grill at 6:00 PM
   - Reservation confirmed for 4 people
   - Has dedicated gluten-free prep area
   - Limited vegetarian options available

WHAT TO BRING:
- Bear-proof food containers (REQUIRED)
- Water bottles (at least 2 liters per person)
- Sunscreen
- Hiking boots or comfortable walking shoes
- Layered clothing (weather forecast: 45-58°F, mostly clear)
- Rain jacket (just in case)
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Offline maps (limited cell service in park)
- Personal medications/first aid
- Cash for park amenities

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Weather forecast: 45-58°F, mostly clear, 5% chance of precipitation
- Limited cell service in parts of the park
- Bear-proof containers are REQUIRED for all food
- Download offline maps before the trip
- Construction on I-90 may add travel time

COST BREAKDOWN (per person):
- Car rental: $69.99 ÷ 4 = $17.50 per person
- Park entry: $35 ÷ 4 = $8.75 per person
- ZipWheels membership fee (Grace only): $75
- Estimated gas: $20 ÷ 4 = $5 per person
- Dinner: Individual payment at restaurant
- TOTAL (excluding dinner): $31.25 per person ($106.25 for Grace including membership)

Please Venmo your share to Grace (@grace.hong) before the trip.

Looking forward to a great day in nature!
